content: include_dir crate (fabro fork_ask_docs.rs, 2026-09-22): Dir::files() lists only the IMMEDIATE directory — nested corpora need an explicit dir.dirs() recursion; Dir::get_file(rel_path) IS slash-path recursive and safe against traversal by construction; include_dir!(/../../../docs/x) prefix escapes the crate dir for repo-root assets; embed only the curated roots (docs/public at 43M dwarfed everything).

content: A replaced OpenAPI schema (with_replacement) needs three touch points; missing any fails downstream tests with E0432 while build.rs stays silent: (1) the schema + property refs in docs/public/api-reference/fabro-api.yaml, (2) the with_replacement entry in lib/foundation/fabro-api/build.rs, (3) the hand-maintained pub use fabro_types::... re-export list inside fabro-api/src/lib.rs's types module (fabro-3488 pass: only (3) made fabro_api::types::ServerSeedsSettings resolve). Corollary: a stale clippy fingerprint can replay an already-fixed E0432 after cargo check passes on the same tree — touch the crate's lib.rs to force a rebuild before re-diagnosing.

description: rustfmt joins backslash-newline continuations INSIDE format! literals into one line but KEEPS the indented whitespace as literal spaces (observed fabro sprint 19: a 21-space run inside a user-facing 422 detail; fmt and clippy cannot see inside literals). User-facing message literals inside format! are written as ONE line or assembled outside format!. Reviewer corollary: verify RENDERED bytes with a tiny print/rustc check, not source literals.
resolution: single-line message literals; render-verify in review
